items.exampleEn: We had to bring the meeting forward to Monday.
items.exampleZh: 我們只好把會議提前到星期一。

items.exampleEn: By noon, the sky had cleared up.
items.exampleZh: 到了中午，天空已經放晴了。

items.exampleEn: The old cinema closed down last year.
items.exampleZh: 那家老電影院去年倒閉了。

items.exampleEn: Nobody came forward with any information.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人站出來提供任何消息。

items.exampleEn: Cross out any word that is spelled wrong.
Dinosaurs died out long before humans appeared.
items.exampleZh: 恐龍早在人類出現以前就滅絕了。

items.exampleEn: It took me a while to fit in at my new school.
items.exampleZh: 我花了一段時間才融入新學校。

items.sentenceEn: Please cross it out and write it again.

items.audioEn: The bookshop on our street is closing down next month, so everything is half price this week.
items.audioZh: 我們這條街上的書店下個月就要關門了，所以這週全部半價。
options: The shop will soon stop doing business
The owner wants to open a bigger branch nearby

items.sentenceEn: Our new cat fits in well with the family.
items.sentenceZh: 我們新養的貓和家人相處得很融洽。

items.sentenceEn: I'd like to clear a few things up about the plan.
items.sentenceZh: 我想澄清關於這個計畫的幾件事。

items.stemEn: To avoid the rainy season, the school ____ the sports day by a week.
items.stemZh: 為了避開雨季，學校把運動會提前了一週。

items.stemEn: Some old customs have slowly ____ as young people move to cities.
items.stemZh: 隨著年輕人搬到城市，一些老習俗已經慢慢消失了。

items.passageEn: After the old fish market stopped running, many people in the area worried that the neighborhood would lose its character. Then a group of young artists rented the empty building and turned it into a studio. At first, they did not fit in with the older residents, who found their music too loud. However, when several families needed help repairing their old houses, the artists came forward to help. Since then, the two groups have become good friends.
items.passageZh: 老魚市場停止營業後，這一帶很多人擔心社區會失去原本的特色。後來，一群年輕藝術家租下那棟空建築，把它改成工作室。一開始，他們和年紀較大的住戶處不來，因為住戶覺得他們的音樂太吵。不過，當好幾戶人家需要幫忙修理老房子時，這些藝術家主動站出來幫忙。從那以後，兩群人就成了好朋友。

questions.questionZh: 藝術家們剛開始為什麼和老住戶處不來？
options: 他們把房子漆成怪顏色
老住戶覺得他們的音樂太吵

questions.questionZh: 後來兩群人的關係怎麼樣？
options: 老住戶要求藝術家離開

items.promptZh: 這種語言大約一百年前就消失了。
referenceEn: This language died out about a hundred years ago.
About one hundred years ago, this language died out.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「消失」（例如 died out 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 disappeared、vanished、fell out of use 等）
有「一百年前」，用過去式（例如 died out 等）

items.promptZh: 天氣預報說今天下午會放晴。
referenceEn: The weather report says it will clear up this afternoon.
According to the forecast, the weather will clear up this afternoon.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「放晴」（例如 it will clear up 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 it will be sunny、the sky will clear 等）
用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、is going to 等）；轉述時寫 said … would clear up 也正確
「天氣預報說」可寫，例如 the weather report says、according to the forecast 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「提出（建議）」是 bring forward 的另一個常見意思（bring forward a proposal／plan），當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：bring forward 干擾項「提出（建議）」（bring forward a proposal 也成立）換成「取消」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「打掃乾淨」是 clear up 的另一個常見意思（clear up the mess／clear up after the party），當干擾項不妥；distractorsZh/1「整理」同理。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：clear up 干擾項「打掃乾淨」「整理」（clear up the mess 也成立）換成「起床」「劃掉」「滅絕」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：SUS：干擾項「熄滅」是 die out 的另一義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["熄滅","用完","離開"]；改後：["退出","用完","離開"]
